SELECT CODE_CODE, CODE_DESC1 FROM codes WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'DAMAGE'
AND CODE_CODE > 50
ORDER BY CODE_CODE

SELECT CRG_TYPE FROM GPHDR_G WHERE TRUCK_REG_NO=#{TRUCK_REG_NO}
AND GP_NO=#{GP_NO}

SELECT H.GP_NO AS GP_NO, TO_CHAR(H.SRVY_DTTM + (SELECT TO_NUMBER(PARAM_VALUE)/24 FROM PARAMETER_OM WHERE PARAM_NM = #{PARAMVAL}),'dd-mm-yyyy hh24:mi') AS GP_EXPDATE, DECODE(H.CRG_TYPE,'AU','VEHICLE CARGO','PC','GC','BULK') As CARGO_TYPE, (SELECT B.CSTM_BOE_NO FROM BOECRGHDR_G B , BOECRGDTLS_G D1 WHERE B.INT_BOE_NO = D1.INT_BOE_NO AND D1.INT_IGM_EA_CRG_SEQ_NO = D.INT_APPLN_IGM_CRG_SEQ_NO) AS BOENO, (SELECT GC.CARGO_CATEGORY_DESC FROM GCB_CARGO_CAT_MAPPING_DTLS GD , GCB_CARGO_CATEGORY GC WHERE GC.CARGO_CATEGORY_ID = GD.CARGO_CATEGORY_ID AND GD.DETAIL_ID = PP.DETAIL_ID) AS GOOD_DESCRIPTION, (SELECT GD.PKG_TYPE FROM GCB_CARGO_CAT_MAPPING_DTLS GD WHERE GD.DETAIL_ID = PP.DETAIL_ID) AS PKG_TYP, NULL AS CHASISNO, I.MARKS_NOS AS MARKS_NOS, NVL(D.CNFM_UNIT_CNT,D.CNFM_TOT_WT) AS GP_ITEM_QTY, D.CNFM_TOT_WT AS GP_ITEM_WT, P.PREGP_NO AS GP_REF_NO, NULL AS GP_STATUS, NULL AS GP_TYPE, H.TRUCK_REG_NO AS VEHICLE, TO_CHAR(H.ADT_INS_DTTM,'dd-mm-yyyy hh24:mi') AS GP_DATE, NULL AS CONTR_NO, NULL AS SEAL_NO, (SELECT PTY.PTY_nm FROM PTY_IM PTY WHERE PTY.PTY_CD= PP.CSNE_CD ) AS CUST_NAME, NULL AS CONTR_SIZE, NULL AS CHASIS_UNIT, NULL AS INSPN_AUTH, NULL AS ACTION_DESC, NULL AS INSP_REMARKS, NULL AS REMARKS, NULL AS SOUTH_JAFZA, NULL AS CUST_HOLD, NULL AS CUST_REMARKS FROM GPHDR_G H, GPDTLS_G D, PREGATEHDR_G P, IGMCRG_VW I, PREGATEDTLS_G PP WHERE H.INT_GP_NO = D.INT_GP_NO AND H.TRUCK_REG_NO = #{TRUCK_REG_NO} AND P.INT_PREGP_NO = H.INT_PREGP_NO AND (P.SELF_DRIVE_FLG ='N' or P.SELF_DRIVE_FLG IS NULL) AND P.INT_PREGP_NO = PP.INT_PREGP_NO AND D.INT_APPLN_IGM_CRG_SEQ_NO = I.INT_IGM_CRG_SEQ_NO AND D.INT_PKG_SEQ_NO = I.INT_PKG_SEQ_NO AND H.CRG_TYPE != 'RORO' AND H.SRVY_DTTM > SYSDATE - (SELECT TO_NUMBER(PARAM_VALUE)/24 FROM PARAMETER_OM WHERE PARAM_NM = #{PARAMVAL}) UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(GPM.GATE_PASS_NO) AS GP_NO, TO_CHAR(GPM.CREATED_DATE + (SELECT TO_NUMBER(PARAM_VALUE)/24 FROM PARAMETER_OM WHERE PARAM_NM = #{PARAMVAL}),'dd-mm-yyyy hh24:mi') AS GP_EXPDATE, GCC.CARGO_TYPE As CARGO_TYPE, B.DPC_BOE_NO AS BOENO, GCC.cargo_category_desc AS GOOD_DESCRIPTION, GCCMD.PKG_TYPE AS PKG_TYP, NULL AS CHASISNO, B.MARKS_NO AS MARKS_NOS, NVL(CCGP.MAPPING_QTY,CCGP.MAPPING_WEIGHT) AS GP_ITEM_QTY, CCGP.MAPPING_WEIGHT AS GP_ITEM_WT, (SELECT GA_NO FROM GATE_ADVICE_HDR GAH WHERE GAH.GA_ID=GPM.GA_ID) AS GP_REF_NO, NULL AS GP_STATUS, NULL AS GP_TYPE, GPM.TRUCK_NO AS VEHICLE, TO_CHAR(GPM.CREATED_DATE,'dd-mm-yyyy hh24:mi') AS GP_DATE, NULL AS CONTR_NO, NULL AS SEAL_NO, (SELECT V.PARTY_NAME FROM V_PARTY_FULL V WHERE GCCM.CUSTOMER_CODE=V.PARTY_CODE AND GCCM.CUSTOMER_TYPE=V.CUSTOMER_TYPE) AS CUST_NAME, NULL AS CONTR_SIZE, NULL AS CHASIS_UNIT, NULL AS INSPN_AUTH, NULL AS ACTION_DESC, NULL AS INSP_REMARKS, NULL AS REMARKS, NULL AS SOUTH_JAFZA, NULL AS CUST_HOLD, NULL AS CUST_REMARKS FROM GCB_CARGO_CAT_MAPPING_DTLS GCCMD, GCB_CARGO_CAT_MAPPING GCCM, GATE_PASS_MASTER GPM, CARGO_CAT_GATE_PASS_MAPPING CCGP, GCB_CARGO_CATEGORY GCC, BOL B WHERE CCGP.GATE_PASS_ID = GPM.GATE_PASS_ID AND GPM.TRUCK_NO = #{TRUCK_REG_NO} AND CCGP.CARGO_CAT_DETAIL_ID = GCCMD.DETAIL_ID AND GCCMD.MAPPING_ID = GCCM.MAPPING_ID AND B.BOL_NO = GCCM.BOL_NO AND B.BOL_UNIQUE_IND = GCCM.BOL_UNIQUE_IND AND B.BOL_SPLIT = GCCM.BOL_SPLIT AND B.rotn = GCCM.ROTATION_NO AND GCC.CARGO_CATEGORY_ID = GCCMD.CARGO_CATEGORY_ID AND GCC.CARGO_TYPE != 'RORO' AND GPM.CREATED_DATE > SYSDATE - (SELECT TO_NUMBER(PARAM_VALUE)/24 FROM PARAMETER_OM WHERE PARAM_NM = #{PARAMVAL}) AND GPM.CALM_GP_NO IS NULL AND GPM.GATE_PASS_NO IS NOT NULL

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GC_EXT_TRUCK_MOVE(REC_ID,GATE_TYPE,GATE_LOCATION, TRUCK_NO,DOC_NO, DOC_TYPE,REF_DOC_NO, REF_DOC_TYPE,TIMESTAMP, SECURITY_ID,IS_VALID, CREATED_BY,CREATED_DATE,REMARKS) VALUES (#{REC_ID},#{GATE_TYPE},#{GATE_LOCATION}, #{TRUCK_NO},#{DOC_NO}, #{DOC_TYPE},#{REF_DOC_NO}, #{REF_DOC_TYPE},#{INOUTDATE}, #{SECURITY_ID},#{IS_VALID}, #{CREATED_BY},#{CREATED_DATE},#{REMARKS})
mapper.select: SELECT E.VEHICLE_CITY_CODE AS REG_PLACE,E.VEHICLE_PLATE_CODE AS PLATE_CODE,E.VEH_NO AS VEH_NO FROM EGP_GATE_PASS E where E.GP_NO =#{GPNO} UNION SELECT SUBSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,1,INSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,' ')-1) AS REG_PLACE, DECODE((LENGTH(H.TRUCK_REG_NO) - LENGTH(REPLACE(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,' '))),1,NULL,SUBSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,INSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,' ',1,1)+1,INSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,' ',1,2)-INSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,' ',1,1))) AS PLATE_CODE, DECODE((LENGTH(H.TRUCK_REG_NO) - LENGTH(REPLACE(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,' '))),1,SUBSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,INSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,' ')+1),SUBSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,INSTR(H.TRUCK_REG_NO,' ',1,2)+1)) AS VEH_NO FROM GPHDR_G H WHERE H.GP_NO =#{GPNO} UNION SELECT SUBSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,1,INSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,' ')-1) AS REG_PLACE, DECODE((LENGTH(GPM.TRUCK_NO) - LENGTH(REPLACE(GPM.TRUCK_NO,' '))),1,NULL,SUBSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,INSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,' ',1,1)+1,INSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,' ',1,2)-INSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,' ',1,1))) AS PLATE_CODE, DECODE((LENGTH(GPM.TRUCK_NO) - LENGTH(REPLACE(GPM.TRUCK_NO,' '))),1,SUBSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,INSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,' ')+1),SUBSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,INSTR(GPM.TRUCK_NO,' ',1,2)+1)) AS VEH_NO FROM GATE_PASS_MASTER GPM WHERE To_CHAR(GPM.GATE_PASS_NO) =#{GPNO} UNION SELECT GAH.CITY_CODE AS REG_PLACE,GAH.PLATE_CODE AS PLATE_CODE,GAH.VEH_NO AS VEH_NO FROM GATE_ADVICE_HDR GAH where GAH.GA_NO =#{GPNO} UNION SELECT SUBSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,1,INSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,'-')-1) AS REG_PLACE, DECODE((LENGTH(H.TRUCK_NO) - LENGTH(REPLACE(H.TRUCK_NO,'-'))),1,NULL,SUBSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,INSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,'-',1,1)+1,INSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,'-',1,2)-INSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,'-',1,1))) AS PLATE_CODE, DECODE((LENGTH(H.TRUCK_NO) - LENGTH(REPLACE(H.TRUCK_NO,'-'))),1,SUBSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,INSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,'-')+1),SUBSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,INSTR(H.TRUCK_NO,'-',1,2)+1)) AS VEH_NO FROM AUC_GATE_PASS_MASTER H WHERE H.GATE_PASS_NO = #{GPNO}
